```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<ol><li>Step 1<ol><li>Step 1a</li><li>Step 1b</li></ol></li><li>Step 2</li></ol>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);

}
```
